params.text: Proxzy POC is built and passing: Rust + eframe/egui app in app/, cargo build clean, --screenshot writes a 2880x1664 PNG (app/shots/now.png) and exits. Features: traffic list/filters/search, inspector tabs, Copy URL/cURL/body, share modal, Repeat, Composer with real system-curl sends, Map Local rules, Breakpoint modal (request/response edit, Continue/Abort), Log Dashboard, and an in-app Guide & Stack page with full-access language. Trap: views.rs is included into app.rs with include!, so edit it as app module code (fields are private). Remaining known gaps: no system-wide HTTPS interception/certificate (demo capture feed), and no original screenshots so visual match is an estimate. If continuing: add a real local proxy engine behind a feature flag, and screenshots of each view once reference images exist. Start pages via PROXZY_VIEW=guide|composer|map|breakpoints|logs.

params.text: FINAL: Proxzy POC builds (cargo build), 11 tests pass, and rebuild_check reports build passed plus app-screenshot passed (2880x1662), 'This would pass.' The app now detects booted iOS simulators and Android emulators/phones before any certificate action: app/src/devices.rs scans xcrun simctl and adb on a worker thread, and Live Capture shows a Detected devices card with READY/NOT BOOTED pills and a per-device Connect… button. Clicking opens a confirmation modal (Connect and trust / Certificate only / Cancel); iOS uses the clicked UDID with xcrun simctl keychain <UDID> add-root-cert, restarts that simulator and sets the Mac web proxy, while Android uses the clicked adb serial for 10.0.2.2 or the LAN IP and pushes the CA to /sdcard/Download. The Guide has a new 'Connect real traffic from a simulator or emulator' section with two step-by-step columns, manual commands and troubleshooting. PROXZY_DEMO=connect opens the modal for screenshots. Fresh shots: shots/device-live.png, shots/device-guide.png, shots/device-modal.png. Traps: views.rs and rules_ui.rs are textually included into app.rs, so never add mod declarations; never touch /Applications/Proxyman.app; only build inside app/; never start dev servers or watchers. Next move: none required.
